The untried step is to attack the VOLATILE half first rather than the callee-saved half: give the tier expression its own statement shape so the level load and the quotient share a destination (the target's in-place divw), and re-measure whether the r22/r24 pair follows. Every callee-saved lever on the pair is already dead (see denial).
